levels.title: Level 1.1: Neural Traversal
levels.objective: Perform an Inorder Traversal to extract the neural sequence.
levels.hint: Inorder visits left branch, root pod, then right branch.

levels.title: Level 1.2: Neural Reconstruction
levels.objective: Reconstruct the binary tree from traversal blueprints.
levels.hint: Use the Preorder + Inorder sequences to rebuild the hive.

levels.title: Level 1.3: Hive Metrics
levels.objective: Calculate and verify Tree Height and Diameter.
levels.hint: Height measures vertical levels; diameter measures the longest path.

levels.title: Level 1.4: Synaptic Convergence (LCA)
levels.objective: Locate the Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA) and path between pods.
levels.hint: Find the deepest shared ancestral pod between branches.

levels.title: Level 1.5: Bilateral Reflection
levels.objective: Invert the hive structure using Tree Mirroring.
levels.hint: Swaps left and right children recursively across the trunk.

levels.title: Level 2.1: The Target Pod
levels.objective: Locate key 60 in the BST using binary search comparisons.
levels.hint: Keys smaller go left; keys larger go right.

levels.title: Level 2.2: Grafting Treasure
levels.objective: Insert key 45 into the BST without violating ordering rules.
levels.hint: Trace the synaptic path to an empty leaf location.

levels.title: Level 2.3: Severing Nodes
levels.objective: Delete key 30 (2-child node using inorder successor).
levels.hint: Inorder successor is the smallest pod in the right subtree.

levels.title: Level 2.4: Subtree Scanning
levels.objective: Execute a Range Query [30, 70] and dim skipped subtrees.
levels.hint: Branches outside the range boundaries are bypassed.

levels.title: Level 2.5: Degenerate Prevention
levels.objective: Insert key 88 and inspect BST height progression.
levels.hint: Balanced insertions prevent trees from degenerating into linked lists.

levels.title: Level 3.1: Balance Detection
levels.objective: Inspect Balance Factor badges: BF = height(left) - height(right).
levels.hint: A balanced AVL node has |BF| <= 1.

levels.title: Level 3.2: Single Rotations (LL & RR)
levels.objective: Demonstrate Single Rotations: LL (Right rotation) or RR (Left rotation).
levels.hint: Click 'Demo LL' or 'Demo RR' to rebalance the vault.

levels.title: Level 3.3: Double Rotations (LR & RL)
levels.objective: Demonstrate Double Rotations: LR or RL to restore balance.
levels.hint: Click 'Demo LR' or 'Demo RL' to execute the double pivot.

levels.title: Level 3.4: Autonomous Balancing
levels.objective: Insert key 15 and observe automatic rebalancing.
levels.hint: AVL trees autonomously detect imbalances and trigger rotations.

levels.title: Level 3.5: Order Statistics
levels.objective: Extract the 3rd smallest key in O(log N) using Subtree Sizes.
levels.hint: Augmented subtree sizes enable fast order-statistic queries.

levels.title: Level 4.1: Chamber Assembly
levels.objective: Build a Max Heap from raw elements using Floyd's algorithm.
levels.hint: Bottom-up heap construction runs in optimal O(N) time.

levels.title: Level 4.2: Priority Repair
levels.objective: Execute Sift Down on root [0] to restore heap property.
levels.hint: Parent must be greater than or equal to both children.

levels.title: Level 4.3: Apex Extraction
levels.objective: Extract the Maximum element from the chamber root.
levels.hint: Root is severed, last element promoted, and sifted down.

levels.title: Level 4.4: Ascending Sort
levels.objective: Execute Heap Sort to sort all elements into the 1D memory array.
levels.hint: Repeated extract-max places elements in final sorted order.

levels.title: Level 4.5: Priority Mastery
levels.objective: Insert priority element 99 and verify Max-Heap validation.
levels.hint: Appends to end and sifts up to highest priority position.
